# SafeOrStolen - Stolen Item Verification Platform

> SafeOrStolen is an **AI-powered** stolen item verification platform — the only service that covers ALL secondhand item types and uses AI to analyze marketplace listing URLs. Powered by Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet for SafeOrStolen AI (conversational verification assistant), smart identifier detection, scam scoring, and risk analysis. Check IMEI, VIN, serial numbers, and firearm serial numbers against 100+ law enforcement databases. 2 free checks, then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited.

## AI Features (SafeOrStolen AI)

- **SafeOrStolen AI** — conversational verification assistant at https://safeorstolen.com/ai-chat and https://safeorstolen.com/verify (powered by Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
- **AI Smart Identifier Detection** — auto-detects IMEI, VIN, serials, plates, firearm serials from text, images, and URLs
- **AI Scam Checker** — 0-100 risk score for marketplace listings (https://safeorstolen.com/scam-checker)
- **AI Marketplace URL Analyzer** — scrapes 6 marketplaces and extracts identifiers via AI (https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker)
- **AI Visual OCR** — camera-based identifier capture in the mobile PWA
- **AI Safety Advisor** — natural-language risk explanations for every result
- **AI Predictive Alerts** — proactive watchlist and victim notifications
All AI runs on Anthropic Claude (claude-sonnet-4-5) via the Lovable AI Gateway.

## What is SafeOrStolen?

SafeOrStolen is a consumer protection platform that verifies whether secondhand items are stolen before purchase. It checks IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, serial numbers, and firearm serial numbers against 100+ databases including FBI NCIC, NICB, GSMA Device Registry, ATF eTrace, carrier blacklists, BikeIndex, and HotGunz. Results in approximately 3 seconds. The only multi-category verification service with a mobile app.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2017 by Samuel Pfeiffer (CEO)
- Co-Founder: Kelly McEvoy
- Incorporated: 2025 in Arizona
- Legal Name: SafeOrStolen LLC
- Location: Peoria, Arizona, United States
- Databases: 100+ including FBI NCIC, NICB, GSMA, ATF eTrace, carrier blacklists (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile)
- Pricing: 2 free checks (no credit card required), then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited
- Verification speed: ~3 seconds
- Item types: Phones (IMEI), vehicles (VIN), license plates, firearms, bicycles, electronics, laptops, tools, jewelry, appliances, eBikes, boats
- Mobile app: Progressive Web App with barcode scanning (iOS and Android)
- Unique feature: Marketplace URL Analyzer — paste listing URLs from 6 platforms
- Accelerated by FasterCapital (LaunchUp Program, 2025)

## Services

- [IMEI Checker](https://safeorstolen.com/imei-checker): Verify phones against GSMA and carrier blacklists
- [VIN Lookup](https://safeorstolen.com/vin-checker): Check vehicle theft status via NICB and law enforcement
- [Firearms Check](https://safeorstolen.com/firearms-check): Check gun serial numbers against ATF, FBI NCIC (7M+ records), HotGunz, 50 state databases
- [Serial Number Check](https://safeorstolen.com/serial-number-checker): Verify electronics, tools, and equipment
- [License Plate Lookup](https://safeorstolen.com/license-plate-lookup): Vehicle registration and theft verification for all 50 states
- [Marketplace URL Analyzer](https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker): Paste listing URLs from Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp to auto-check
- [AI Scam Checker](https://safeorstolen.com/scam-checker): Free AI-powered marketplace scam detector (0-100 risk score)
- [Seller Badge](https://safeorstolen.com/seller-badge): Generate verification badges for marketplace listings
- [Mobile App](https://safeorstolen.com/app): PWA with barcode scanning

## How It Works

1. Enter IMEI, VIN, serial number, license plate — OR paste a marketplace listing URL
2. SafeOrStolen queries 100+ databases simultaneously
3. Results returned in ~3 seconds: SAFE, STOLEN, LOST, or flagged
4. Download verification certificate or share report

## Pricing

- Free: 2 verifications, no credit card required
- Per-check: $0.99 per verification
- Unlimited: $10/month, all item types, cancel anytime
